Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.ott

Interface OneTimeCodeRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
JdbcOneTimeCodeRepository
public interface OneTimeCodeRepository
Port that stores the numeric one-time codes. An implementation never returns null.

    • save

      void save(OneTimeCode code)
      Stores a code, replacing any other active code of the same binding and user name so that only the latest one can be used.
      Parameters:
      code - the code to store.

    • findActive

      Optional<OneTimeCode> findActive(String bindingId, String username, Instant now)
      Finds the code that is still active for a binding and a user.
      Parameters:
      bindingId - identifier binding the code to the requesting browser session.
      username - user name of the account.
      now - current instant; an expired code is not active.
      Returns:
      the active code, or empty when there is none.

    • incrementAttempts

      int incrementAttempts(UUID id)
      Counts a wrong submission, in one atomic step.
      Parameters:
      id - identifier of the code.
      Returns:
      the number of attempts after the increment, or 0 when the code no longer exists.

      id - identifier of the code.
      Returns:
      true when the code existed and is now spent.
